study_type: cross-vendor extension; adds claude-sonnet-4-6 and claude-opus-4-6 to the frozen GPT v3 sample set; post-hoc, not part of the original v3 protocol
model_id_verification: Confirmed 2026-09-27 via Agent tool MODEL_ID self-report test (3-sample mini batch, zero tool uses): model alias sonnet -> claude-sonnet-4-6; model alias opus -> claude-opus-5-5 (ps aux showed an older claude-opus-4-6 session; the Agent tool opus alias resolves to claude-opus-5-5 as of this date). Both models reported correct JSON output format and used zero tools.
transport_note: Claude CLI subprocess (claude -p) returns 'OAuth session expired' in subprocess context. The Agent tool spawns fresh isolated model instances via the desktop app OAuth session. This is the only available non-API-key interface for these models.
instructions: This is a text-only controlled classification experiment. Use only the supplied prompts and your existing knowledge. Do not use tools, inspect files, browse, delegate, or ask questions. Classify every sample from its own prompt. Do not infer labels from IDs, sample order, other samples, or an assumed class distribution. Return only the requested JSON array.
shared_task_visible_to_tested_model: instructions + full prompt file content only; no conversation history, no project context, no memory, no tools
inference_unit: One fresh Agent-tool session per model/condition/repeat, with all selected observations in one fixed batch

failure_policy.semantic_failure: Incomplete prediction count, ID mismatch, invalid label, malformed JSON → N/A; original response retained

metadata_availability.token_usage: Not available via Agent tool interface; not captured
metadata_availability.server_returned_model_id: Not directly returned by Agent tool; model_requested records the model alias passed to the tool
metadata_availability.stop_finish_reason: Not available via Agent tool interface
metadata_availability.request_session_id: Not available via Agent tool interface
metadata_availability.temperature: Not set; default model temperature used; not exposed
metadata_availability.reasoning_budget: Not set explicitly; defaults to model's own reasoning; not equivalent to GPT reasoning_effort=medium

comparability_note: GPT v3 used Codex CLI with reasoning_effort=medium and disabled tools at infrastructure level. Claude extension uses Agent tool where tool prohibition is instruction-level only. Hidden base instructions, reasoning settings, and inference infrastructure differ between vendors. Only the visible task input (instructions + prompt text) and output format are shared. Cross-vendor accuracy comparisons should account for these differences.
scoring_policy: Freeze all session results before opening answer labels. Score all predeclared sessions. N/A sessions recorded as failed, not excluded.
ci: 95% Wilson for accuracy; group percentile bootstrap for macro F1 and paired differences
answer_key_isolation: Answer keys not read until all session results frozen
